snippet.title: Rachit Jain
snippet.description:
I am Rachit Jain, an IIT Roorkee Alumnus, and a Software Engineer at Microsoft.  

I talk about - 
1. Data Structures and Algorithms
2. Competitive Programming
3. Problem Solving
4. Motivation
5. Learning Mindset
6. Success and Winning
7. Failures and Reactions
8. Cracking Interviews

I have given lots and lots of interviews with Google, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, Directi, Hackerrank and received job offers from all of them, except for one ;)    
I have worked with Microsoft, Flipkart, Grofers, HackerEarth, Codechef and also delivered lectures in IIIT-H about problem solving and logical reasoning.  

Subscribe, watch video and comment so that we learn from each other! 

If you want to invite me as a speaker for some event, contact me at my Facebook page, LinkedIn profile.
